text.card: A red giant 4,267 parsecs away, 23 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.98 solar masses and 23.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,600 K at its surface.
